name: dealer_search_by_location
description: Searches for pesticide and seed dealers in a specified location. Location (village/district/state) is MANDATORY. Returns dealer names, addresses, and basic info. PUBLIC tool — no authentication required. Does NOT verify dealer license or check inventory. Queries without valid location are INVALID. Fails if location invalid or no dealers found in the area.

name: dealer_filter_by_product
description: Filters dealers by product type and crop compatibility. Returns dealers that carry matching products. PUBLIC tool. Location is required. Does NOT verify dealer status or product availability. Fails if location missing, crop_type unsupported, or no matches found.

name: dealer_get_details
description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific dealer including name, address, contact, products carried, and license status. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT verify license — use dealer_verify_license. Data may be stale or contain inconsistencies. Fails if dealer_id invalid.

name: dealer_verify_license
description: Verifies the government-issued license status of a dealer. Returns license_status ('valid', 'expired', 'suspended') with expiry date. PUBLIC tool. Unlicensed or expired dealers should NOT be used for purchases. Does NOT update license records. Fails if dealer_id invalid or license data unavailable.

name: dealer_check_inventory
description: Checks product availability at a specific dealer. Returns inventory_status ('available', 'limited', 'unavailable') for specified product. PUBLIC tool. Inventory data is dynamic and may not reflect real-time stock. Does NOT reserve products. Fails if dealer_id invalid or dealer not active.

name: dealer_compare_options
description: Compares multiple dealers by product availability, license status, distance, and ratings. Location is required. PUBLIC tool. Comparison is based on available data which may be stale. Does NOT guarantee accuracy of all fields. Fails if fewer than 2 dealers available for comparison or location invalid.

dealer_ids.description: List of dealer IDs to compare. Optional — auto-selects nearby if omitted.

name: dealer_resolve_location_ambiguity
description: Resolves ambiguous location names to precise district/state matches. Returns possible matches with context. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT search dealers. Fails if no matches found.

name: dealer_resolve_duplicate_entries
description: Identifies and flags potential duplicate dealer entries that may appear due to data inconsistencies. Returns grouped entries with similarity scores. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT remove duplicates. Fails if no duplicates detected.

dealer_name.description: Dealer name to search for duplicates. Optional.

name: dealer_get_nearest
description: Returns nearest dealers sorted by distance from farmer's location. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT verify license or check inventory. Distance is approximate. Fails if location invalid or no dealers in radius.

location.description: Farmer's village, district, or GPS coordinates.

max_distance_km.description: Maximum search radius in km. Optional, default 50.

name: dealer_get_recommendations
description: Provides dealer recommendations based on crop type, location, and product needs. Requires session_token (personalized). Recommendations are advisory only. Does NOT guarantee product availability. Fails if crop_type unsupported or no dealers match.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for preference and grievance tools.

name: dealer_save_preference
description: Saves a dealer as a preferred/favorite dealer for the farmer. Requires session_token. Does NOT guarantee future availability. Fails if dealer_id invalid or session expired.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for preference and grievance tools.

name: dealer_raise_grievance
description: Raises a grievance about a dealer. Categories: 'fake_dealer', 'expired_license', 'wrong_information', 'product_not_available', 'safety_violation'. Must verify dealer details first. Requires session_token. Does NOT resolve grievance. Fails if category invalid or dealer_id not verified.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for preference and grievance tools.

name: dealer_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks dealer grievance status. Returns resolution status. Requires session_token. Does NOT raise new grievances. Fails if grievance_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for preference and grievance tools.
